pages.title: FKDB
pages.purpose: Entry and return point for the Fighting Knowledge Decay Browser progression.
pages.recovery_path: Begin with HISTORY or inspect LINEAGE; every progression route returns here.

pages.title: HISTORY
pages.purpose: Preserve sources, failures, chronology and their route back to the current need.
provenance: FKDB specification: history and failure retention
pages.recovery_path: Inspect DECAY next or return HOME.

pages.title: DECAY
pages.purpose: Expose what consequential meaning, relation, provenance or recovery route became unreachable.
provenance: FKDB query state and Fighting Knowledge Decay specification
pages.recovery_path: Proceed to RECOVER or return HOME.

pages.title: RECOVER
pages.purpose: Relate, rebuild and verify knowledge without replacing source identity.
provenance: FKDB query kernel and Fighting Knowledge Decay specification
pages.recovery_path: Proceed to RELATE after bounded reconstruction or return HOME.

pages.title: RELATE
pages.purpose: Reconnect recovered knowledge while preserving provenance and preventing authority transfer.
pages.recovery_path: Return to the FKDB current common point with result and remainder.

pages.title: TOOLS
pages.purpose: Inspect local tool bridge availability without requiring remote services.
pages.recovery_path: Return HOME; start the local bridge or import portable artifacts when local adapters are unavailable.

pages.title: LINEAGE
pages.purpose: Preserve Independent Browser to FKDB successor identity without retroactive renaming.
